notes: The purpose of this procedure is to inform the network about an MCG failure the UE has experienced i.e. MCG radio link failure.

A UE in RRC_CONNECTED, for which AS security has been activated with SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB setup or, for IAB, SRB2, may initiate the fast MCG link recovery procedure in order to continue the RRC connection without re-establishment.
